headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Utilize public trend signals to improve the accuracy and relevance of risk assessments in ClearInstall, making it more effective at identifying potential issues before installation. Integrate real-time package dependency tracking and enhance user notifications for better decision-making.
actions: Integrate real-time package dependency tracking from popular repositories like npm and PyPI to ensure that all dependencies are up-to-date and secure.
